BASIC FUNCTION : Position has primary responsibility for the operational procedure and process associated with contractual arrangements/agreements for goods and services procured by the University. Also responsible for preaward and/or postaward functions for a variety of supply, service, and/or construction contracts for several activities within an organizational component or in a geographical area. The employee is responsible for a variety of contracts which frequently require special handling provisions or other specialized terms and conditions. Some contracts cover a period of more than one year. Typical requirements include technical equipment, supplies, construction, and services ranging from standard items which are complicated by urgent delivery requirements or security classification to complex or sophisticated requirements. Examples include equipment or services needed to support a research and development activity; ADP equipment, software and related services; conversion of installation functions from in-house to contract operations; negotiated contracts with disadvantaged business firms; contracts for Principal Investigators and other specialized services and equipment for Research or a Hospital; construction projects related to new buildings, roads, docks, and others which consist of standard design and specifications; negotiation of contract modifications and change orders caused by inadequate existing drawings, defective specifications, or changed site conditions; alteration and repair projects such as those requiring the demolition and removal of existing walls and windows, relocation of heating and air conditioning systems, and modification of primary lighting and communication channels; contracts for design and/or engineering services, other technical services, and technical equipment and supplies; or contracts for acquisition and installation of building equipment systems.

SUPERVISORY

AUTHORITY: None

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include the Office of the General Counsel, executives, administrators, managers, faculty, staff and students of the University departments, units and offices. External contacts include Federal, state, local and other governmental sponsors of research/training programs at Howard University, private foundations, vendors, auditors, inspectors and other representatives working on behalf of program sponsors, representatives from other universities, institutes and other organizations with whom Howard University works on sponsored research/training programs and industry trade organizations (such as the National Contract Management Association and the National Council of University Research Administrators and others)

PRINCIPAL

Accountabilities

Prepares documentation and legal draft of contracts/agreements, ensuring contract/agreement requirements are met, and works directly with Compliance Office and Office of General Counsel (OGC) to ensure contract/agreement language and requirements are appropriate and complies with Howard University and Hospital policies and procedures, and federal and state laws, to resolve compliance issues

Maintains confidentiality and protects sensitive data at all times, including patient & student, and proprietary information.

Coordinates work with various departments and serves as a liaison between HU and vendors to oversee the intake, review and finalization of all contracts that bind the University.

Maintain University Contracts and systems to ensure timely renegotiation and consistency of language/terms in order to provide maximum legal coverage.

Examines the operational scope of contracts, working collaboratively with user departments to ensure compliance.

Serves as a consultant and educator to management and administrative staff relating to contract/agreement compliance requirements and issues.

Review and analyze contracts not requiring legal review and identify language issues and/or concerns.

Provides guidance to technical personnel involved in the development of the statement of work or data requirements. Formulates the contracting approach to be taken that will best satisfy the requirement.

In formally advertised procurements, ensures that the bid schedule is properly structured, prepares the solicitation, determines sources to be solicited, conducts prebid conferences, processes protests, determines the responsiveness of bids and determines the responsibility of the apparent low bidder based on an analysis of financial and technical information gained during the preaward survey, and awards or recommends award of the contract.

In negotiated procurements, the employee plans the procurement action with technical, legal, and contract pricing personnel. Provides guidance in the development of the statement of work and data requirements, determines the type of contract best suited to the requirement, develops special clauses and terms and conditions applicable to the solicitation. Determines the sources to be solicited, prepares applicable determinations and findings, conducts preproposal conferences, receives and evaluates proposals in conjunction with price/cost analysts or other technical personnel, determines the competitive range in negotiations with one or more offerors, prepares award documents and makes presentation to a contract board of awards or source selection authority when appropriate. Responds to inquiries, including formal protests and congressional inquiries.

Monitors contractor performance in relation to the completion schedule required by the contract, insuring timely submission of technical progress reports, making periodic visits to the contractor's facility or work site, detecting and correcting labor standards violations, taking appropriate action to expedite delivery or performance when required by mission changes, monitoring the contractor's use of University-furnished property inventories, and issuing change orders occasioned by changes in mission requirements, defective specifications, changed site conditions, or changes in University-furnished property. Negotiates settlements for such changes, approves contract payments, assesses liquidated or actual damages for nonperformance, issues show cause or cure notices, terminates contracts for default or convenience and negotiates settlements, prepares replies to other involved agencies, appeal boards, or congressional inquiries.

Coordinates review of issues list with management staff. Negotiate all required language changes and review final documents to ensure all changes are appropriately made. Prepare correspondence necessary to accomplish the finalization of contracts being processed.

Create contract files, negotiate changes, coordinate full and final execution of all contract documents, maintain Master Contract Filing system, administration and maintenance of the Contract Management Database, to include; monitoring, follow-up and resolution of all renewal notifications; scan and add all finalized contracts, amendments and insurance certificates to the database.

Monitors Contracts Administration e-mail and responds to customer inquiries in a professional, courteous and prompt manner no later than one business day after receipt of inquiry.

Maintains the highest degree of confidentiality with respect to information relating to business transactions and HU employees, patients, guests, physicians, co-workers and vendors.

Assists in the preparation of training manuals and training documentation for on-going contracts training, ensuring that manuals are updated appropriately with the newest version of procedures.

Assists with training faculty, staff, and students on legal issues in grants and contracts administration.

Promotes adherence to the Health Sciences Compliance Program, the Howard University Code of Ethics and the Health Sciences Standards of Conduct.

Attends annual and periodic mandatory Compliance Program training including the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Privacy training.

Participates in activities that promote adherence to federal healthcare program requirements.

Actively participates in Health Sciences Compliance Program activities.

Adheres to the requirements of the HIPAA Privacy Policies and Procedures.

Maintains confidentiality of patients, families, faculty, students, and staff.

Performs other job related duties within the assigned timeframes assigned by Director.

Core Competencies

Sensitive to the interrelationship of both people and functions within the department.

Ability to apply strict confidentiality regarding budget issues.

Strong team building and interpersonal skills

Strong project and relationship management skills

Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious working relations with staff, University officials and the general public

Good communication skills

Customer service orientation

Must be able to read and interpret the underlying purpose of contractual agreements, including the concepts of offer and acceptance and bargained-for transaction.

Knowledge of the healthcare industry and of University purchasing practices, procedures and techniques is also desirable.

Must be comfortable communicating instructions and process information to customers of all levels within the organization, including executive leaders.

Comprehensive knowledge of Government Contracting and related laws, regulations and guidelines such as FARS.

Comprehensive knowledge of the terminology related to the sponsored research agreements.

Comprehensive knowledge of basic contracting phases such as pre-award award and post-award.

Comprehensive knowledge of principles, practices and methodologies of accounting including grant administration and budget policies and procedures

Knowledge of computer skills: spreadsheet, database, word processing, and presentation software as well as other standard office equipment. Ability to use technology – contract management software and a standard suite of office software applications

Ability to organize information, generate reports and maintain data regarding contracts and contract process requests in a database.

Comprehensive knowledge of basic contracting phases such as pre-award award and post-award.

Comprehensive knowledge of principles, practices and methodologies of accounting including grant administration and budget policies and procedures

MINIMUM

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field of study

5 to 10 years experience in an academic, healthcare environment or an equivalent combination of relevant experience and training.

Experience with Workday

Experienced with the Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR/DFAR) a plus

Possession of a Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM), Certified Federal Contracts Manager (CFCM), a Certified Research Administrator, or Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) certification is preferred.

Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position description at any time. This position description is not be construed as a contract for employment.

$75,000-$85,000

title: Board Program Coordinator
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Reporting to the Director of Board of Visitors Operations and to the Associate Secretary of the Board, the Board Program Coordinator will provide assistance and coordination of three Board stakeholder initiatives: the Board of Visitors Program; the Alumni Leadership Academy; and TCIAC, an advisory group that supports the identification of candidates for volunteer opportunities across the University. The Coordinator will also serve as a member of the team of the Office of the Secretary and will be expected to assist as necessary at all in person and virtual Board of Trustees meetings and events.

Nature And Scope

Provide support for the Board of Visitors (BOV) Program, which consists of 14 Boards of Visitors, one for each of Howard University’s Schools and Colleges. Under the direction of the Director of BOV Operations, the Coordinator will support and manage assigned administrative and operational activities related to the oversight of the Board of Visitors Program.

Supervisory Accountability

N/A

Principal Accountabilities

Board of Visions Program

This includes tracking and monitoring candidates and members through the membership cycle. The Coordinator will support the maintenance and ongoing updates of BOV operational documents, templates, trackers, and reporting tools. The Coordinator will support the Director on BOV meetings and assist in planning the Biennial Congress of the Board of Visitors Program. As relates to the BOV Program, the Coordinator will report to and work with the Director of BOV Operations.

Alumni Leadership Academy (ALA) and TCIAC

The Coordinator provides comprehensive support for the Alumni Leadership Academy (“the Academy”), which is designed to facilitate meaningful engagement between Board of Trustee members and the alumni community. Under the direction of the Associate Secretary, the Coordinator will work with select members of the Governance Committee and colleagues in Development and Alumni Relations (DAR); the Coordinator will schedule, plan, and execute virtual and in-person Academy sessions and engagement opportunities. Responsibilities include coordinating logistics; assisting with the identification, scheduling, and management of speakers and facilitators; ensuring timely communications; and serving as the principal point of contact for internal and external stakeholders. The Coordinator will attend meetings, as required. The Coordinator will manage and staff the Academy’s annual application and selection cycle, including scheduling selection committee meetings, tracking applicant and cohort data, maintaining program records and keeping Academy communications and website content current. For the Trustee Candidate Identification Advisory Council (TCIAC), the Coordinator will provide broad support for TCIAC, which acts in an advisory role to the Governance Committee of the Board to assist in broadening the pool of potential candidates considered by the Committee, and engaging the Howard University community in identifying potential candidates for various volunteer roles. Working with select member(s) of the Governance Committee of the Board of Trustees, the Coordinator will attend all meetings of TCIAC, keep records, and track proposed candidates for volunteer roles at the University, including candidates for BOV membership and for trusteeship. As relates to the Alumni Leadership Academy and TCIAC, the Board Program Coordinator will report to the Associate Secretary.

Core Competencies

  • As a member of the OS team, the Coordinator will provide additional support as requested, including for any additional community engagement initiatives emanating from the Board. The Coordinator will participate in providing staff support for all regular and special meetings of the Board.
  • Strong programmatic experience. Organized, detail oriented, and able to take direction, follow through on instructions, and prioritize tasks based on organizational priorities and urgencies.
  • Solid writing skills and excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Must possess a high degree of discretion, confidentiality and judgment.
  • Skilled in Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe, and document management.
  • Able to work effectively under time-pressure, shifting priorities or Board-driven deadlines.

Minimum Requirements

Project Management experience preferred. Must be strongly team oriented. Bachelor’s degree required.

Expected Salary Range: $80,000 - $85,000

title: Back-end Developer
description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

  • Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency.
  • Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems.
  • Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets.

What You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models.
  • System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems.
  • Rapid Delivery: Adopt a "deliver fast" mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards.

Paths to Work on the Project

  • Streaming & High-Throughput Data
    • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.
    • Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings.
  • GenAI & Autonomous Agents
    • Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating.
    • Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers
  • Graph & Knowledge Engineering
    • Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data.
    • Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal.

Qualifications

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data.
  • GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs.
  • Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search).

Desired Profile

  • Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph.
  • Modern Pythonista: You are up-to-date with modern Python async patterns and typing, ensuring code is high-performance and maintainable.
  • You understand Big O notation and how to optimize code for CPU/memory efficiency.

Must Haves

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development.
  • Advanced English communication skills.
  • Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI).

Good To Have

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

title: Front-end Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Complexity: Rendering massive tables and managing strict validation logic for mission-critical data pipelines.
  • Interactivity: Building conversational UIs (streaming chat) and high-performance time-series dashboards that update in real-time.
  • Visualization: Designing intuitive interfaces for Data Lineage, Knowledge Graphs, and Entity Mapping.

You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, ensuring design consistency across the platform while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • Component Architecture: Create a reusable, strictly typed Angular component library that scales across AI, Dashboard, and Admin modules.
  • Performance: Optimize change detection strategies and virtual scrolling to ensure the UI remains responsive and performant, whether rendering a live data stream or a 3D object.
  • Data-Driven Design: Handle complex JSON schemas and heavy payloads, ensuring data precision from API to UI

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Data Platform & Management Tools

  • Build Management Interfaces: Develop the "Control Room" for Data Engineers, including Data Catalog and Pipeline Configuration screens.
  • Heuristics & Mapping: Create efficient workflows for "Entity Matching" that allow users to visually map raw sensor tags to physical assets.
  • Visualizing Lineage: Implement DAG visualizations (D3.js or similar) to allow users to trace data asset layers and dependencies.

AI Interfaces & Visualization

  • Build AI Assistant UI: Develop rich conversational interfaces that support streaming responses (SSE), markdown rendering, and interactive "artifacts".
  • Advanced Dashboarding: Implement high-performance time-series charts using Plotly.js, ensuring smooth zooming/panning on large datasets.
  • Document Handling: Develop integrated viewers for PDF documents and rich media, allowing Agents to cite sources visually.

The Technology Stack

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Framework: Angular 16+ (Expert level), TypeScript, RxJS.
  • State Management: NgRx or Signals.
  • Visualization: Plotly.js (Time-series), D3.js/DAGs (Lineage).
  • API Integration: REST APIs (FastAPI), Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSockets (using Socket.io)

Qualifications

  • Component Architect: You write clean, decoupled components and understand how to build a UI kit that scales.
  • UX Sensibility: You understand that a "Chat" interface needs to feel immediate and care about loading states and smooth transitions.
  • You take pride in building tools that make other engineers productive, caring deeply about workflow efficiency and keyboard shortcuts.

Must Haves

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 5+ years of experience in Frontend Development (Angular focus).
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and reactive programming patterns.
  • Experience building Admin Dashboards, B2B SaaS interfaces, or complex SPAs.
  • Ability to handle complex API integrations and data modeling on the client side.
  • Advanced English communication skills

Good To Have

  • Visualization: Hands-on experience with Plotly.js, D3.js, or Lineage/DAG graphs.
  • AI/Chat: Experience building Chat/LLM interfaces and handling streaming text.
  • Data Heavy: Familiarity with high-performance libraries and virtual scrolling.
  • Media/Geo: Experience with PDF rendering in-browser or Map/GIS libraries (Leaflet, Mapbox).

Job Title: Associate Director of Assessment

Full/Part Time: Full-Time

Regular/Temporary: Regular

Howard University Mission

Howard University is a comprehensive, research-oriented, historically Black private university providing an educational experience of exceptional quality to students of high academic potential with particular emphasis upon the provision of educational opportunities to promising Black students. Further, the University is dedicated to attracting and sustaining a cadre of faculty who are, through their teaching and research, committed to the development of distinguished and compassionate graduates and to the quest for solutions to human and social problems in the United States and throughout the world.

Position Information

Salary Commensurate With Qualifications, Education & University Guidelines.

Basic Function: This position takes a lead role in planning and assessment activities coordinated by Institutional Research & Assessment (IRA), under the Office of the Provost. Specifically, this position coordinates all surveys (external and internal) within IRA and coordinates all technology platforms.

Supervisory Accountability: May be responsible for supervising and directing work of undergraduate and graduate students.

Nature And Scope: Internal contacts include Deans, Department Chairs, staff, faculty, and students. External contacts include affiliated schools, national research centers, and assessment/student learning organizations.

Principal Accountabilities

Facilitates engagement in and provides support and direction for the assessment of the general education curriculum.

Designs, administers, and analyzes institutional surveys.

Supports assessment and accreditation activities across the university through consulting, review, and technical support.

Co-manages assessment platform for the university (Watermark), offering technical support, troubleshooting, updating users, and creating support material for users.

Manages course evaluation platform (Course Evaluations & Surveys by Watermark) and coordinates with campus partners regarding its effectiveness and efficiency.

Leads the administration, research and reporting related to university survey initiatives such as student engagement (NSSE), faculty survey (FSSE), First-Year experience (CIRP), Course Evaluations and internal university survey projects administered via Qualtrics.

Serves as a central support unit for internal surveys across campus (Qualtrics training, survey consulting, survey creation and distribution for university leadership).

Performs other duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

Working knowledge of the literature on learner-centered assessment and evaluation, general education, rubrics as an assessment tool, high impact educational practices, surveys, response rates, and best practices in higher education assessment.

Experience executing a large-scale project successfully, from conceptualization through completion.

Ability to take direction, assume increasingly independent responsibility, and provide appropriate follow up on project-based work.

Ability to guide assistant director(s) and coordinator(s) to set deadlines, manage project completion, and develop staff.

Possess strong analytical, communication, interpersonal, and reporting-writing skills.

Ability to create visual analytics and performance dashboards.

Ability to work in a collaborative environment.

Experience with designing, administering, and reporting on data from surveys. Knowledge of social science research methods.

Experience with curriculum or instructional design.

Experience with a data management platform (e.g., Watermark/Taskstream, TracDat, Anthology/CampusLabs) and survey management tools (e.g., Qualtrics, Survey Monkey).

Experience providing program accreditation support (e.g., AACSB, CAEP, SACSCOC, MSCHE) in a higher education setting.

Experience using and manipulating data, including familiarity with statistical analysis (e.g., SPSS, SAS) and/or database (e.g., Access, SQL Server) software applications.

Minimum Requirements

Master's degree in higher education or other discipline and a minimum of five years professional experience in academic outcomes assessment and/or institutional assessment and related activities within a higher education setting (preferably institutional research, faculty development, institutional effectiveness, or assessment). Alternatively, as faculty directly overseeing assessment functions or earned doctoral degree. Supervisory experience.

Com mais de 60 anos de história, transportamos bauxita, minério de ferro, celulose e muito mais — conectando rotas no Brasil e no exterior, com segurança, consistência e compromisso com um futuro mais sustentável. description:
GUARACAMP!
Há 30 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marca raiz, autêntica como o carioca. Somos o Guaraná Natural mais amado do Rio de Janeiro , e temos orgulho da nossa história de crescimento com os pés no chão, foco em resultado e paixão pelo que fazemos.
Sangue Verde — orgulho de pertencer e atitude de dono. Cuidamos da empresa como se fosse nossa, percebemos o que precisa ser feito e agimos com senso de urgência.
Fazemos o que tem que ser feito, sem desculpas. Somos gente que arregaça as mangas, vai pra cima e entrega resultado.
Transparência é Lei: jogamos limpo, falamos com clareza e resolvemos as coisas com verdade e respeito.
Acreditamos que Tudo pode ser feito melhor — nada é definitivo, e evoluir é parte da nossa essência.
E, claro, Fazemos mais com menos: valorizamos cada recurso, buscamos eficiência e mantemos a qualidade em tudo que fazemos.

Atividades

  • Executar manutenções preventivas, preditivas e corretivas em máquinas, equipamentos e instalações, de acordo com as ordens de serviço.

  • Planejar e organizar as atividades de manutenção, incluindo a preparação de ferramentas, materiais e procedimentos necessários.
  • Elaborar e revisar procedimentos técnicos de manutenção e sugerir melhorias em máquinas e sistemas.
  • Monitorar e manter os níveis adequados de óleo em sistemas hidráulicos e realizar ajustes conforme especificações do fabricante.
  • Garantir a limpeza e conservação das ferramentas, equipamentos e área de trabalho após a execução das atividades.
  • Aplicar técnicas de segurança e cumprir normas ambientais durante todas as etapas da manutenção.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos e realizar plantões.
  • Supervisionar processos de manutenção e acompanhar profissionais terceirizados, prestando suporte e orientação.
  • Participar da montagem e instalação de novos equipamentos, seguindo instruções do fabricante e orientações superiores.

title: TÉCNICO DE ENFERMAGEM ESF - AP 1.0
description:
Job description

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Main responsibilities

Desempenhar as atividades técnicas de enfermagem, prestando assistência ao paciente de forma a zelar pelo seu conforto e bem estar, realizando registros e relatórios técnicos, bem como organizando o ambiente de trabalho em conformidade às boas práticas, normas e procedimentos.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Médio e Curso Técnico de Enfermagem Completos;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho de Classe;
  • Experiência de no mínimo 6 (seis) meses, na função proposta.

Additional information

Local de trabalho: AP 1.0 (Região Central do Rio e Paquetá)

Horário de trabalho: 40h semanais

description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Drilling Engineer to join the Gas Drilling Engineering Department.

The Gas Drilling Engineering Department is responsible for providing the development of gas drilling and workover engineering with non-associated gas and highly complex horizontal and vertical gas wells. Identifying and introducing innovations that enhance monitor and support operation and safety.

Your primary role is to gather and analyze information to provide sound drilling technical support to drilling operations, drilling equipment, projects and drilling technical services requiring sound drilling engineering analysis and solutions.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Provides sound drilling engineering methods and procedures to be used on assigned drilling problems.
  • Executes and accomplishes assignments and studies in areas outlined in the scope assuring conformance to overall objectives of all phases of drilling operations in areas including: drilling penetration rate optimization, new drilling technology and drilling studies.
  • Provides technical assistance and advice to operating divisions on complex operating problems.
  • Initiates detailed work outlines and performs or delegates work for final development of technical proposals and studies of proposed.
  • Analyzes data and performance of new or existing techniques to determine need for or benefit from studies, recommendations and/or facility modifications with respect to unit costs and operating efficiency consistent with established safety and operating requirements.

As the successful candidate you will hold a:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Petroleum, Mechanical or Chemical Engineering or related Engineering discipline from an accredited university.
  • 7+ years of experience in drilling field.

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Join our team!

title: Head of Competition Management and Team Services
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services shall have dual reporting to the Team Services and Competition Management departments in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful management and implementation of the Team Services and Competition Management projects for the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (“FWWC”).

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services will work together with the Team Services and Competition Management Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure:

  • the best possible standard of team facilities can be provided for the tournament across Brazil
  • the best possible standard of Competition and Match Operations can be delivered by the Competition Management team at the tournament
  • efficient and smooth team and competition operations can be put in place by the Team Services and Competition Management team jointly with the relevant functional areas before and during the tournament

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Implement the Team Services project, under the direction of the FIFA Team Services department in FIFA HQ Zurich

Implement the Competitions project, under the direction of the FIFA Competition Management department in FIFA HQ Zurich

Lead and manage the (FIFA27) Competition Management and Team Services sub-division which includes Team Services, Competition Management, Training Site Infrastructure and Referees Management

Be responsible for the LFS (FIFA27) parts of project management for Competition Management & Team Services

Develop the LFS’ (FIFA27) Competition Management & Team Services budget, under the guidance of the FIFA Team Services and FIFA Competition Management departments, and regularly review and report to also ensure alignment

Work closely with the relevant governmental and non-governmental institutions, the national, regional and local football community in all matters related to Competition Management and Team Services (under the guidance of the FIFA HQ Zurich team)

Represent Competition Management and Team Services at required key and strategic meetings as well as site inspections when necessary

Ensure overall efficient communication channels to all other functional areas within the LFS (FIFA27) as well as to external partners

Overseeing the planning & delivery of all competition related events, such as FIFA test events, the Draw, the Team Seminar and Team Workshop as well as FIFA Refereeing’s seminars and workshops, in close collaboration with the FIFA counterparts focusing on the delivery part of the Local Entity;

Oversee and supervise the recruitment, training, management of the Competition Management & Team Services team members in Brazil

Collaborate with the Infrastructure & Technical Services team on all stadium and team equipment requirements (i.e., Team Materials, Field of Play Equipment, Training Site Equipment) to ensure procurement, delivery, and placement.

Be responsible for reporting on a regular basis to the FWWC Senior Management Team

Team Services specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):

  • Oversee the delivery of all team facilities according to the FWWC Hosting Requirements
  • Oversee the planning, coordination and implementation of all services to be delivered to the teams according to FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines
  • Ensure consistency in terms of levels of services and standards across all Host Cities
  • Be responsible for the planning and implementation of all team/referees’ operations with focus on the coordination with the local parties
  • Overview and supervise FIFA Team Services and Refereeing staff inspections as well as the teams’ inspection visits in Brazil as required
  • Ensure support for the FIFA Refereeing team on any pre-tournament organised seminars and workshops
  • Manage all LFS (FIFA27) Team Services staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC

Competition Management specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):

  • Oversee the successful operational coordination and delivery of Competition Management, according to the guidance given by FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Monitor and ensure all stadium competition areas construction/refurbishment are in alignment with FIFA Hosting Requirements, in conjunction with FIFA27 Venue Management
  • Plan and delivery of competition and stadium readiness exercises and training materials
  • Prepare written reports and presentations on the progress of Competition Management matters
  • Manage all LFS (FIFA27)
  • Competition Management staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC

YOUR PROFILE

  • A minimum sports event management experience of 10 years, ideally on an international level in either the Team Services area or the Competition Management area or both
  • Extensive and well-founded international football knowledge
  • Extensive knowledge of event and competition/match operations as well as sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organizational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Strong management and leadership skills
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro

description:
Selecione a frequência (em dias) para receber um alerta:

Psicopedagogo(a) - Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Localização: Rio de Janeiro, BR

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Procuramos um(a) Psicopedagogo(a). Neste papel você irá coordenar, supervisionar, encorajar e avaliar mediadores sob sua responsabilidade. Deve ser alguém que valoriza conversas respeitosas, escuta ativa e justiça.

O que você fará:

  • Adaptar materiais e atividades pedagógicas, em português e inglês, para alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Ter e buscar conhecimento das dificuldades, habilidades e interesses dos alunos, para fundamentar as supervisões dos mediadores;
  • Demonstrar conhecimento de ferramentas, materiais e estratégias para auxiliar o trabalho dos mediadores sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Definir objetivos diferenciados para os alunos, a partir de avaliação de seus níveis de desenvolvimento real para que possam atingir níveis desejáveis de desenvolvimento;
  • Coordenar os mediadores quanto ao planejamento de atividades de avaliação coerentes com as necessidades e habilidades dos alunos, bem como com a instrução planejada;
  • Manter comunicação frequente com Coordenadores de Atendimento, Coordenadores de Segmento e professores de alunos de seu segmento, compartilhando informações sobre o desempenho dos alunos e buscando apoio necessário;
  • Se comunicar, sempre que necessário, com a família e com outros profissionais que trabalham com os alunos sob sua responsabilidade fora da escola, compartilhando informações necessárias para o bom atendimento dos alunos;
  • Demonstrar profissionalismo através de manutenção de confidencialidade de informações, compromisso com o crescimento dos mediadores, compromisso com horários e manutenção de ambiente justo e ético.

Procuramos manter a transparência: nenhuma atividade é restritiva; a lista pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se apliquem ao cargo.

O que você precisar ter:

  • Pós-graduação em Psicopedagogia;
  • Experiência com mediação e inclusão de alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Experiência com alunos do segmento da vaga;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

OInspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

The Global Industry Leader for the Natural Resources and Energy sector is responsible for developing and delivering a strategic growth plan for the industry vertical. They build strong client relationships and lead business development initiatives. This role will be responsible for driving the successful implementation of the industry strategy across all client segments and regions, partnering with colleagues across business lines to harness broader Aon relationships to drive growth.

  • Develop and Implement Industry Growth Strategy: Define and implement a strategic plan to expand market share within the vertical, including identifying market opportunities and setting clear objectives.
  • Build and Maintain Client Relationships: Cultivate strong, trusted relationships with key client partners, understanding their business challenges and proactively identifying ways the firm can add new value.
  • Lead Business Development Efforts: Drive regional pipeline generation and conversion by identifying and prioritizing new opportunities and supporting regional sales teams on large enterprise deals.
  • Deliver Thought Leadership: Represent the firm as an industry expert by publishing insights, speaking publicly at conferences, and participating in industry forums to raise Aon's profile and credibility.
  • Lead Financial Performance: Oversee the vertical’s financial health, including revenue targets, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation.
  • Develop and Grow Industry-Focused Teams: Mentor, and develop talent with relevant industry expertise, fostering a collaborative and impactful team culture.
  • Collaborate Across the Organization: Work closely with other vertical leaders, service line leads, and regional leaders to harness broader firm capabilities and client relationships.
  • Monitor Industry Trends and Regulatory Changes: Stay abreast of industry developments, regulatory shifts, and emerging risks to ensure the firm’s offerings remain relevant and compliant.
  • Drive Innovation and Solution Development: Identify client needs and market gaps, leading the development of new services, solutions, and delivery models tailored to the vertical.
  • Lead Collaborator Communication: Provide regular updates to executive leadership and other interested parties on vertical performance, critical initiatives, and key challenges.

How this opportunity is different

As a thought leader and industry expert, you will represent the firm in the market, track industry trends, and drive the creation of innovative, industry relevant and client-focused solutions. This is a pivotal leadership position for a committed professional with deep industry and reward expertise and a passion for delivering value to clients.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Ten plus years of experience in compensation.
  • Proven track record in the Natural Resources and Energy segment leading and driving growth in a complex global environment. Exceptional influential leadership.
  • Fluency in the English language.
  • Deep understanding of Human Capital universe and needs of clients across all segments, with strengths across Rewards and Analytics.
  • Hands‑on experience of shaping and executing against a client‑focused vision.
  • Proven track record of building go‑to‑market strategies and driving sustained results over both a short and long‑term horizon.
  • Ability to lead strategic thinking around innovation and ideation with a strong client and commercial lens.
  • Exceptional communication skills to convey compelling messages across all levels and geographies.
  • Ability to work in a matrixed environment and lead through influence.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in relevant discipline or equivalent years of industry experience.

How we support our colleagues

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage a diverse workforce. Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work… and we are all for it. We call this Smart Working!

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

title: Sr Business Development Manager, Flights LATAM
description:
About The Job

As a Business Development Manager, Airline Partnerships, you will support and grow relationships with a portfolio of airline distribution partners, helping to drive revenue growth and long-term collaboration. You will represent the company in day-to-day airline partner interactions, working closely with internal teams to execute commercial initiatives, support partner needs, and contribute to enterprise growth goals. This role requires a mix of account management, sales execution, and analytical skills. At Hopper, you can have an immediate impact in a high‑growth environment. Airline sales and distribution is a specialized field, so prior experience in airline distribution (OTA,MC, GDS, airline, etc.) is a strong plus, particularly within the LATAM market. Successful candidates will be able to clearly communicate Hopper’s value proposition and effectively our products and capabilities to airline partners.

What Your Day-to-day Would Look Like

  • Support the management of a portfolio of airline accounts, contributing to growth strategies and execution plans
  • Track partner performance, analyze results, and help identify risks and growth opportunities
  • Build a strong understanding of partner business objectives and assist in developing initiatives aligned with their strategy
  • Identify opportunities to improve commercial relationships and collaborate with internal teams to address them
  • Help organize and participate in quarterly business reviews with airline partners
  • Partner with finance teams to support forecasting and revenue tracking for airline partnerships
  • Assist in developing and executing marketing initiatives and insertion orders (I/Os) with airline partners in support of growth goals
  • Support contract negotiations, renewals, and amendments in collaboration with senior team members
  • Act as a liaison between airline partners and internal teams to ensure smooth operational execution and a strong traveler experience
  • Develop a working knowledge of the global travel market, with a focus on airline industry dynamics

An ideal candidate has

  • 3–5 years of experience in sales, business development, or account management with a track record of supporting revenue growth
  • Prior experience in airline distribution (OTA, TMC, GDS, or airline), with exposure to or experience in the LATAM market preferred
  • Familiarity with commercial, cultural, and regulatory dynamics of the LATAM travel ecosystem
  • A positive, proactive, and self‑motivated attitude
  • Ability to prepare and deliver clear, data-driven presentations
  • A collaborative, team-first mindset
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and time management skills
  • A detail-oriented and analytical approach to problem‑solving
  • Passion for travel, technology, and digital commerce
  • Foundational value-selling skills and commercial acumen
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English & Portuguese

Perks And Benefits Of Working With Us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre‑IPO equity packages
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR-offered health, dental, life and short-term disability insurances with SulAmerica
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers
  • Very generous parental leave
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work-from-home stipend
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business
  • Open communication with management and company leadership
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact

More About Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels.

As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen‑Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros. Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.

A área de IAM é responsável por garantir que cada pessoa e sistema tenha o acesso certo, no momento certo e apenas ao que precisa, usando ferramentas como Entra ID, Active Directory e SailPoint. Ela cuida de todo o ciclo de vida do usuário, desde a criação da conta, mudanças de função, até o desligamento, além de controlar acessos, autenticações e integrações com sistemas internos e SaaS.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Operar e dar suporte ao ambiente de Identidade e Acesso;
  • Garantir que usuários, sistemas e aplicações tenham os acessos corretos e seguros;
  • Tratar chamados de IAM dentro do SLA de atendimento;
  • Acompanhar e corrigir falhas de provisionamento e desprovisionamento;
  • Apoiar criação, alteração e remoção de acessos no MS Entra ID, Active Directory, SailPoint e aplicações integradas;
  • Executar e acompanhar os fluxos de Joiner, Mover e Leaver;
  • Apoiar revisões de acesso e campanhas de certificação;
  • Testar e validar integrações via SCIM e APIs usando Postman;
  • Rodar e ajustar automações simples em PowerShell;
  • Documentar/atualizar processos;
  • Apoiar na governança.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD);
  • Experiência com Active Directory (on-premises e híbrido);
  • Experiência com SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC);
  • Conhecimento em Identity Lifecycle Management (Joiner, Mover, Leaver);
  • Conhecimento em processos de provisionamento e desprovisionamento de contas e acessos;
  • Conhecimento em RBAC (controle de acesso baseado em papéis);
  • Noções de auditoria de acessos, revisões e compliance (SoD, Least Privilege);
  • Experiência com Postman para testes e validação de integrações.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em SCIM;
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST, JSON e Web Services;
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de autenticação e autorização (OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0 e OpenID Connect);
  • Experiência com ferramentas ITSM, como Freshservice;
  • Conhecimento em PowerShell e/ou Python;
  • Experiência com Logic Apps e Azure Functions;
  • Conhecimento em Azure Key Vault (AKV) para gestão de segredos, credenciais e tokens;
  • Conhecimento em workflows, rules e transforms no SailPoint ISC;
  • Experiência com integração de aplicações corporativas e SaaS;
  • Noções de segurança em APIs;
  • Certificações em IAM, Cloud ou Segurança da Informação.

Local

Rio de Janeiro-RJ ou São Paulo-SP

OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.

Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco;
  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

QUEM SOMOS

Quem Somos: Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos.

Diversidade e inclusão

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

E para desenvolver ainda mais a nossa liderança temos o Be Leader* – um programa interno exclusivo que acontece anualmente para fomentar o aprendizado e a conexão do nosso time de Líderes.

NÓS SOMOS HEINEKEN!

No Brasil, já crescemos muito e estamos em um novo momento ainda mais movidos pela paixão em sermos a melhor cervejaria para nosso time, parceiros, clientes, consumidores e toda a sociedade. Trabalhamos com marcas incríveis, que as pessoas amam, e com valores que direcionam um modelo de negócio vencedor.

description:
O que nos move

A paixão por esportes é indiscutível. Mas o que realmente nos move é transformar a forma como o esporte é consumido , combinando criatividade, tecnologia, dados e execução em alta velocidade. Na LiveMode , desenvolvemos soluções digitais que conectam clubes, federações, ligas, atletas e marcas ao público de forma relevante, autêntica e inovadora. Nosso objetivo é construir um ecossistema que sustente o esporte nas próximas décadas, integrando o melhor do digital, das redes sociais e da TV .

Com essa visão de futuro, estamos formando um Banco de Talentos para profissionais que desejam atuar como Produtor(a) de Conteúdos – Redes Sociais , jogando junto ao nosso time de Conteúdo , com oportunidades no Rio de Janeiro (100% Presencial) . Mesmo que não tenhamos uma vaga aberta neste momento, seu perfil poderá ser considerado para oportunidades futuras, de acordo com sua experiência, senioridade e os projetos da LiveMode.

Aqui, cada movimento é uma jogada estratégica, e queremos pessoas que entendam o tamanho do jogo.

Responsabilidades

  • Planejar, produzir e publicar conteúdos para redes sociais, garantindo consistência editorial, agilidade e alinhamento com a estratégia de cada projeto.
  • Atuar em coberturas de eventos esportivos, jogos e ativações especiais, incluindo finais de semana e horários alternativos, conforme o calendário esportivo.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com times de Design, Audiovisual, Produto e Comercial, transformando ideias, pautas e dados em conteúdo relevante para diferentes plataformas.
  • Analisar performance e comportamento de audiência, propondo ajustes e novos formatos com base em dados, tendências e contexto esportivo.
  • Contribuir para inovação de linguagem e formatos, acompanhando o que há de mais atual em redes sociais, cultura digital e consumo de conteúdo esportivo.

Requisitos necessários

  • Experiência prévia com produção de conteúdo para redes sociais, seja em veículos de mídia, projetos digitais, marcas ou criadores.
  • Familiaridade com o universo esportivo, entender o jogo importa. Modalidade específica pode variar, mas repertório é essencial.
  • Vivência com rotinas de publicação, cobertura em tempo real e adaptação rápida a mudanças de contexto.
  • Boa comunicação, organização e capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes de alta demanda e múltiplos projetos.
  • Perfil mão na massa, com senso de responsabilidade e execução consistente.

Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Experiência em grupos de mídia, projetos esportivos, plataformas digitais ou streaming.
  • Conhecimento em vídeo para redes sociais, edição básica ou direção de conteúdo audiovisual.
  • Vivência com planejamento de cobertura esportiva, cronogramas editoriais e storytelling multiplataforma.
  • Interesse ou uso prático de IA e novas tecnologias aplicadas à produção de conteúdo.
  • Ideias, projetos autorais ou experimentações que demonstrem inquietação criativa e vontade de fazer diferente.

Nossos benefícios

  • Auxílio Alimentação de R$ 1.250,00 por mês, para utilização em restaurantes, mercados, aplicativos de comida e outros estabelecimentos físicos ou online.
  • Vale Transporte (opcional) caso opte pelo benefício, haverá desconto de 6% do salário bruto, conforme previsto na CLT.
  • Plano de Saúde (Especial – SulAmérica) sem custo mensal para o colaborador, com coparticipação de 10% em consultas e exames. É permitida a inclusão de dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), com custos por conta do colaborador e mesma coparticipação.
  • Plano Odontológico (Mais DOC) sem custo mensal para o colaborador para o plano "Mais Doc", com possibilidade de migração para outros planos (diferença de valor descontada em folha) e inclusão de dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), com desconto em folha.
  • TotalPass e Wellhub (opcionais) o colaborador pode escolher a plataforma que melhor atender às suas necessidades. Ambas oferecem acesso a academias de diversas modalidades, esportes variados e aplicativos de saúde física, mental e financeira.
  • Auxílio-Creche para filhos de até 5 anos e 11 meses, com reembolso de despesas em creches, escolas ou com profissional regularizado (babá ou autônomo).
  • Auxílio para Dependentes PCD para colaboradores que apoiam pessoas com deficiência, mediante apresentação de laudo médico.
  • Seguro de Vida (Prudential) é uma proteção financeira para o colaborador e seus beneficiários em momentos de adversidade.
  • SESC oferece acesso a atividades culturais, esportivas, de lazer, saúde e educação, incentivando um estilo de vida saudável e equilibrado.
  • Open English oferece acesso a cursos de inglês ou espanhol em diversos formatos, com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e familiares.

Nossa cultura

Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte, e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.

SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES ontem, hoje e sempre. Escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.

SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE não uma família ou uma confraria de amigos. Família a gente não escolhe, mas o time escolhe quem joga. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não tá entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo que é melhor pra empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.

SOMOS AMBICIOSOS pensamos sempre grande. A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde.

O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO . Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia.

title: AIDS 2026 Prevention Ambassador Fellowship (Fully Funded)
description:
AIDS 2026 Prevention Ambassador Fellowship (Fully Funded)

The AIDS 2026 Prevention Ambassador Fellowship is a prestigious international fellowship organised by the (IAS) . The fellowship supports digital creators, advocates, and professionals working to advance HIV prevention knowledge, access, and community engagement , with full participation at AIDS 2026 in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

The programme combines funding, global exposure, professional development, and international travel for selected fellows.

Scholarship Details

  • Host: International AIDS Society (IAS)
  • Event: AIDS 2026 – 26th International AIDS Conference
  • Conference Dates: 25 – 30 July 2026
  • Fellowship Period: March 2026 – 14 August 2026
  • Application Deadline: 15 February 2026 (23:00 CET)
  • Financial support of up to USD 500 for a digital HIV prevention content project before AIDS 2026
  • Financial support of up to USD 500 for a digital content project during AIDS 2026
  • Full support to attend AIDS 2026 in person , including:
    • International travel
    • Accommodation
    • Per diem
    • Ground transportation (where applicable)
  • Opportunity to:
    • Amplify HIV prevention messaging globally
    • Translate scientific and policy discussions into accessible digital content
    • Network with researchers, policymakers, activists, and global health leaders
  • Participation in professional development, networking, and advocacy activities

Applicants must meet all of the following:

  • Be 18 years or older at the time of application
  • Have a proven track record in advancing HIV prevention knowledge or access (e.g. PrEP, PEP, U=U, harm reduction, policy, long-acting prevention)
  • Demonstrate content creation experience on HIV prevention through:
    • Social or digital platforms (TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, X, Bluesky)
    • Podcasts, blogs, newsletters, or community radio
  • Have a minimum reach of 5,000 total followers/subscribers across platforms , OR documented community reach and engagement
  • Commit to ethical, evidence-based, non-stigmatizing, rights-based communication
  • Virtual pre-event onboarding

Priority Will Be Given To Applicants Who:

  • Represent or work closely with key and priority populations, including:
    • People living with HIV
    • Men who have sex with men
    • Trans people
    • Sex workers
    • People who inject drugs
    • Adolescent girls and young women
    • Migrants and underserved communities
  • Are based in low- and middle-income countries
  • Produce content for underserved audiences
  • Have experience collaborating with community-led organisations, clinics, or advocacy coalitions
  • Descriptions of two digital HIV prevention communication projects :
    • One to be implemented before AIDS 2026
    • One to be implemented during AIDS 2026
  • For each project:
    • Intended outcomes
    • Planned themes
    • Target audiences
    • Platforms to be used
    • Two sample posts showing how the project would look
  • Portfolio and/or links to recent prevention-related digital content (last 6–12 months)
  • Evidence of reach (screenshots of analytics or engagement metrics)
  • Letter of support (if employed)
  • Letter of reference (if self-employed)

Deadline

  • Application Closes: 15 February 2026 at 23:00 CET

Late or incomplete applications will not be considered.

  • Download and complete the official AIDS 2026 Prevention Ambassador Fellowship application form
  • Prepare all required documents and project descriptions
  • Submit your application before the deadline

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. All application information will be treated confidentially.

FAQs

Is this a fully funded opportunity? Yes. Selected fellows receive funding for digital projects and full support to attend AIDS 2026 in Brazil.

Do I need to be a medical professional? No. Applicants may be content creators, advocates, researchers, community workers, or digital communicators with proven HIV prevention engagement.

Can social media creators apply? Yes. Creators on platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, blogs, podcasts, and community media are encouraged to apply.

Is English mandatory? Yes. English proficiency is required to engage with AIDS 2026 content and communications.

Can applicants from Africa apply? Yes. Applicants from low- and middle-income countries, including African countries, are strongly encouraged to apply.
